summary: La Rosa Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K on August 18, 2026, disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor. The company issued 210 shares of Series E Convertible Preferred Stock at $1,000 per share for gross proceeds of $210,000. The offering was conducted under Rule 506(b) of Regulation D, a routine private placement. No special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, strategic reviews, or capital returns are present. This is a standard unregistered sale of equity securities, not a control transaction or other event warranting a special-situation classification.
